summaries.summary: Human intelligence is described as embracing social and collective wisdom, forming a foundation for general AI.
summaries.title: Introduction

summaries.summary: MAgent is a many-agent reinforcement learning platform designed for collective intelligence research, featuring network sharing and ID embedding for high scalability.
summaries.title: The MAgent Platform

summaries.summary: A large-scale gridworld serves as the fundamental environment for massive agent populations, with agents having rectangular bodies, local detailed perspectives, and optional global information.
summaries.title: Gridworld Fundamentals

summaries.summary: Users can describe rewards, agent symbols, and events via a custom description language in the Python interface, where rewards are assigned when boolean event expressions evaluate to true.
summaries.title: Reward Description Language

summaries.summary: The platform implements parameter-sharing DQN, DRQN, and A2C, with DQN found to perform best and thus primarily used in experiments, alongside efforts to introduce agent diversity.
summaries.title: Baseline Algorithms

summaries.summary: The demo showcases example games on MAgent, allowing visitors to observe deep reinforcement learning applied to large agent populations and interact with the system.
summaries.title: Live and Interactive Part

summaries.summary: Two armies of hundreds of agents each collaborate with teammates to eliminate opponents, learning effective behaviors through simple self-play training.
summaries.title: Battle shows the hybrid of cooperation and competition.

summaries.summary: MAgent is presented as a research platform for many-agent reinforcement learning, enabling studies of AI agent populations at both individual and societal levels.
summaries.title: Conclusion
